fact: The national Internet Governance Forum of 19-20 September 2019 in Antananarivo brought together the universities of Antananarivo, Mahajanga, Antsiranana, Toamasina and Fianarantsoa and the national research centre CIDST, and recommended research and training programmes on internet governance.
title: Recommandations IGF national sur la Gouvernance de l’Internet Madagascar 2019
